source_text:
3.18
Ἀφρικανοῦ Γῆρας ὄφεως φοίνιξιν ἐγκρύψας εἴ τι τῶν ζῴων ψωμίσεις, καθαριεῖς
αὐτοῦ τὰς ἀκροχορδόνας.
pass_a_gloss: 3.18 Of-Africanus. Old-age of-a-snake in-dates having-hidden if some of-the-animals you-feed-morsels, you-will-clean of-it the acrochordonas.
pass_b_english: Of Africanus. Having hidden a snake's slough in dates, if you feed morsels to any of the animals, you will clean its acrochordonas.

choices.why: γῆρας of a snake is the cast skin, the usual medical ingredient, not the snake's old age.

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
